name: product-tour
title: Product Tour
description: A guided tour that highlights parts of the page one step at a time, with a popover, progress and keyboard navigation, as a React hook and component over driver.js.
label: driver.js
author: Kamran Ahmed <https://github.com/nilbuild>

loop.script: wait → click[0] → wait → click[5] → wait → click[5] → wait → click[5] → wait

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps, read when the tour starts. Each has an `element` (a CSS selector, an element, a function or a React ref; none for a centered step) and a `popover` (`title`, `description`, `side`, `align`, button texts and hooks), as in driver.js.

props.name: open
props.description: ProductTour: shows the tour while true.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: ProductTour: called with false when the tour ends on its own (done, close, Escape or an overlay click).

props.name: startIndex
props.description: ProductTour: the step to open at.

props.name: dir
props.description: Popover direction; auto follows the page. In right to left, left and right sides, start and end alignment of top and bottom popovers, the arrow keys and arrow glyphs in button texts are mirrored.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of a step's popover when it has no title.

props.name: onStepChange / onClose
props.description: Called when a step is highlighted, and once the tour has ended however it ended.

props.name: animate
props.description: Fades the overlay and moves the highlight between steps. Labs default follows prefers-reduced-motion; driver.js's own default is always true.

props.name: showProgress / progressText
props.description: The step counter in the popover footer.

props.name: showButtons / disableButtons
props.description: Which popover buttons show, and which are disabled.

props.name: nextBtnText / prevBtnText / doneBtnText / closeBtnLabel
props.description: Button texts (HTML) and the close button's accessible name.

props.name: overlayColor / overlayOpacity / stagePadding / stageRadius / popoverOffset
props.description: The overlay and the cutout around the highlighted element.

props.name: allowClose / overlayClickBehavior / allowKeyboardControl / allowScroll
props.description: How the tour can be closed and navigated.

props.name: ...driver.js config
props.description: Every other driver.js option and hook (popoverClass, smoothScroll, disableActiveInteraction, advanceOnClick, waitForElement, onHighlightStarted, onDestroyStarted, onNextClick and more) passes through.

a11y: Each popover is a role="dialog" named by its title (or by `label` when it has none) and described by its description; the close, previous and next controls are native buttons with names.

Focus moves into the popover on every step and Tab cycles between the popover and the highlighted element; Escape closes the tour, the arrow keys move between steps (mirrored in right to left), and focus returns to the control that started the tour.

The overlay is aria-hidden and the popover's header and footer are not landmarks; the aria-expanded and aria-haspopup attributes driver.js puts on the highlighted element are kept only on roles that support them.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the tour does not animate. Buttons show a focus ring when focused from the keyboard.

The default palette is driver.js's: the close glyph (#d2d2d2 on white, 1.5:1) and button borders are faint. prefers-contrast: more raises them, forced colors use system colors, and the --product-tour-* tokens raise them for everyone.
